ABOUT CYVL

The best infrastructure is invisible. You only notice it when it fails. For decades, the people responsible for our roads, bridges and sidewalks have been asked to manage the physical world with tools that can't see it.

Cyvl is the Physical AI company changing that. We build purpose-built sensors, computer vision and AI that turn every drive into current data: what exists, where it is and what condition it's in. 500+ cities and towns use our Infrastructure Intelligence Platform to direct the work and fix problems before they fail. 1 in 30 Americans drive on roads managed with Cyvl data.

The proof isn't a dashboard. It's a smoother commute, a safer walk to school and public dollars going where they matter most. We're a fast-moving team in Boston building hardware, software and AI for the real world. If you believe technology's highest calling is public good, come build with us.




THE ROLE

Cyvl has one of the largest proprietary datasets of US infrastructure: LiDAR and imagery from hundreds of cities. As an AI Engineer, you'll turn that data into intelligence, from computer vision models that detect and assess assets to LLM-powered agents and tools that let customers and partners ask questions of the physical world. You'll work from prototype to production, shipping models and AI features customers use every day. This role is based in Somerville, MA, or remote from San Francisco, CA.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and improve computer vision and 3D perception models that detect, classify, and assess infrastructure (pavement, signs, sidewalks, trees) from LiDAR and imagery.

 - Build LLM-powered products: agentic workflows, our MCP server, and AI copilots that put Cyvl data to work inside customer tools.

 - Own models from data and training through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production.

 - Design evaluation sets and metrics that tie model performance to what customers actually need.

 - Stay close to the state of the art and bring the right new tools into our products and our own workflows.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years building and shipping ML or AI systems in production

 - Strong Python and a modern deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred)

 - Hands-on experience with computer vision, 3D perception, or LLM applications (RAG, tool use, agents, evals)

 - Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, and cloud deployment

 - Ability to go from an ambiguous problem to a working prototype quickly, then make it production-grade




NICE TO HAVE

 - Point cloud or multimodal work (LiDAR and imagery fusion)

 - Model Context Protocol (MCP), foundation model APIs, or agent frameworks

 - Geospatial or remote sensing background

 - MLOps: model serving, GPU infrastructure, experiment tracking

 - Advanced degree in CS, ML, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience




WHY CYVL

Hard tech. Real streets. Your name on it.

 - Hard problems in the real world. You build end-to-end: our own hardware, software and AI, with work that shows up on the street in the real world.

 - Ownership that compounds. You own outcomes, not tasks. You work directly with customers and across our team, and you'll own more, sooner, than almost anywhere else.

 - Intense, with heart. We're building a category, so it's not a place to coast. We also take care of each other, have genuine fun together, and believe in what we are doing.




WHAT WE ASK

 - Cross lanes. "Not my job" doesn't exist here.

 - Own without a playbook. The plan is still being written, often by you.

 - Try, miss, try again. We make big bets. Some won't land, and we learn fast.

 - Be in the room. We're on-site in Somerville about 90% of the time. If you're based in San Francisco, this role is remote, and you'll be with the team in Somerville for the moments that matter like onboarding, kick-offs, and milestones.

We're a startup building a category. If that sounds like the draw, not the risk, we'd love to talk.




BENEFITS

 - Equity. You'll own a piece of what you're building.

 - Health, dental, and vision. Cyvl covers most of the premium for you and your family.

 - 401k with a real match, vested day one. Your money is yours from the start.

 - Generous PTO & Paid Parental leave. Doing hard work well includes stepping away from it.

 - Learning stipend. Spend it on whatever makes you sharper.

 - Paid to live close. A monthly bonus for living near our Boston office.

 - Team events. Time together in Boston with a team you’ll love working with.




OUR VALUES

 - Real: Authentic and transparent. Focused on solving real problems with simple, effective solutions.

 - All Out: Bold, driven, and committed to delivering results that matter.

 - Accelerating: Always learning, growing, and moving with intention.

 - Reliable: We follow through and deliver at a consistently high bar.

 - Empowering: We lift each other up and help governments build infrastructure they can be proud of.

Company Overview
Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.
We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.
And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.
We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.
Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.
Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.
Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.
With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.
Join us in building the power foundation of the future!
Role Summary
Amperesand is disrupting industrial power with the first commercialized Solid State Transformer (SST) systems. SSTs are far more than transformer replacements — they unlock advanced capabilities for data centers, EV charging, renewables, microgrids, and industrial installations.
To support this mission, Amperesand is building a modern ERP and manufacturing operations software platform that gives our internal teams and external stakeholders real-time visibility, control, and intelligence across the business. We are looking for a motivated intern who wants to build production software across the full stack while learning from a high-agency startup engineering team.
This internship is an opportunity to work hands-on with a startup engineering team building the ERP and manufacturing platform that powers Amperesand's operations. You will contribute across both frontend and backend, helping ship new features, improve reliability, and bring AI-enabled capabilities into our internal tools.
You will work closely with engineers, product owners, and internal and external stakeholders who rely on our proprietary ERP and manufacturing ecosystem every day. This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment where you'll be expected to take ownership of real, production-facing work.
Responsibilities
Build and support full stack features for our internal ERP and manufacturing operations platform, spanning Go backend services and TypeScript/React frontend applications.
Help design and implement new AI-enabled features that improve how internal and external stakeholders interact with the platform.
Support observability and metrics efforts, including instrumenting services, building dashboards, and improving system visibility.
Improve CI/CD pipelines and automated testing to increase release speed and reliability.
Collaborate with backend, frontend, and product teams to define APIs and data contracts.
Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues raised by internal and external users of the ERP and manufacturing ecosystem.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and participate in code review.
Document features, architectural decisions, and processes for cross-functional stakeholders.
Bring a customer-oriented, team-first mindset to a fast-paced startup environment.
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with Go for backend development (coursework, personal projects, or prior internship experience).
Experience with TypeScript and React, including component-based development and state management.
Exposure to AI/LLM concepts or hands-on experience with model training, fine-tuning, or applied AI tooling.
Basic understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Strong communication skills and comfort working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-motivated, team-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
Available to work on-site.
Bonus Qualifications
Experience with observability or metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Exposure to ERP, MES, or other manufacturing/industrial software systems.
Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, or end-to-end).
Prior internship or project experience supporting customers or external stakeholders.
Interest or coursework in energy systems, power electronics, or industrial automation.
Open-source contributions or personal projects demonstrating full stack ability.
Experience with AWS (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, or similar cloud services).
